name: tablecrew-firestore-rules-tests
description: Firestore security rules tests (Milestone F1) for ../../firestore.rules, using @firebase/rules-unit-testing against the Firestore emulator. Run via 'firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "npm --prefix firestore/test/rules test"' from the repo root - see docs/TESTING.md's 'Testing Firestore Security Rules' section and .github/workflows/ci.yml's rules-tests job.
